description:
Why did countries like India become poor after colonisation, but nations like the US, Canada, and Australia become wealthy after the British left? The winners of the 2024 Nobel Prize for Economics have the answer.

#history #colonialism #indianhistory
fulltitle: Why Colonialism Made Some Countries Poor But Others Rich
